mechanisms.label_th: HPA Axis — วงจร Cortisol: Hypothalamus → Pituitary → Adrenal
mechanisms.label_en: HPA Axis Stress Response: CRH → ACTH → Cortisol Cascade
mechanisms.description_th: Stressor (psychological/physical) → hypothalamus หลั่ง CRH → anterior pituitary หลั่ง ACTH → adrenal cortex หลั่ง cortisol; cortisol เพิ่ม blood glucose (gluconeogenesis), ลด immune response, เพิ่ม alertness; negative feedback: cortisol จับ GR ใน hippocampus + hypothalamus → ยับยั้ง CRH/ACTH (ปิดวงจร); chronic stress → GR desensitization → negative feedback ล้มเหลว → cortisol สูงเรื้อรัง
mechanisms.description_en: Stressor → hypothalamic CRH → anterior pituitary ACTH → adrenal cortisol; cortisol raises blood glucose, suppresses immunity, increases alertness; negative feedback: cortisol binds GR in hippocampus/hypothalamus → suppresses CRH/ACTH; chronic stress → GR desensitization → feedback failure → chronically elevated cortisol.

chain.effect: CRH (Corticotropin-Releasing Hormone) released into portal blood
ACTH (Adrenocorticotropic Hormone) secreted into bloodstream
cortisol peaks ~20-30 min after stressor
raises blood glucose, suppresses inflammation, heightens alertness
response shuts down in acute stress
feedback impaired → elevated baseline cortisol → hippocampal atrophy, immune suppression, visceral fat

analogies_th: HPA = alarm system ที่ออกแบบมาให้ดังแล้วหยุด; chronic stress = alarm ดังค้างตลอดเวลา
cortisol = ผู้จัดการฉุกเฉิน — เก่งในวิกฤต แต่ทำลายองค์กรถ้าอยู่ถาวร

sources.title: Stress, Glucocorticoids, and Damage to the Nervous System — Sapolsky RM

mechanisms.label_en: Sympathetic Nervous System Acute Stress: Catecholamine Release
mechanisms.description_th: Immediate threat → amygdala activates (threat detection center) → amygdala signal → locus coeruleus (noradrenaline) + hypothalamus → SNS activation → adrenal medulla → adrenaline + noradrenaline release ภายใน วินาที; effects: HR ขึ้น, BP ขึ้น, bronchial dilation, glycogenolysis ใน liver (glucose for muscles), pupil dilation, blood flow redirected to muscle/brain; gut and immune temporarily suppressed
mechanisms.description_en: Threat → amygdala activates → locus coeruleus + hypothalamus → SNS → adrenal medulla releases adrenaline/noradrenaline within seconds; HR rises, BP rises, bronchodilation, hepatic glycogenolysis, pupil dilation, blood flow to muscle/brain; gut and immunity transiently suppressed.

chain.effect: noradrenaline floods PFC, limbic system within 1-2 seconds
adrenaline + noradrenaline secreted into bloodstream
HR↑, contractility↑, bronchial dilation, hepatic glycogenolysis → blood glucose↑
non-emergency systems paused for short-term survival

analogies_th: SNS = ปุ่ม emergency ที่ทำงานทันที; HPA = backup ที่ตามมาทีหลัง
adrenaline = ยาฉุกเฉินที่ร่างกายฉีดให้ตัวเอง — ดีในวิกฤต อันตรายถ้าฉีดทุกวัน

sources.title: Why Zebras Don't Get Ulcers — Sapolsky RM

mechanisms.label_th: Chronic Cortisol → Hippocampal Atrophy และ Cognitive Impairment
mechanisms.label_en: Chronic Cortisol Exposure Causes Hippocampal Dendritic Retraction and Neuronal Loss
mechanisms.description_th: Cortisol จับ GR ใน hippocampus → เพิ่ม glutamate release (excitotoxicity) → NMDA receptor overactivation → calcium influx → mitochondrial dysfunction → dendrite retraction + reduced neurogenesis (ลด BDNF); chronic = cumulative damage → volume loss; เลิก stress → partial recovery possible (neuroplasticity)
mechanisms.description_en: Cortisol binds hippocampal GR → excess glutamate release (excitotoxicity) → NMDA overactivation → calcium influx → mitochondrial dysfunction → dendritic retraction + reduced neurogenesis (via BDNF suppression); chronic exposure = cumulative volume loss; stress reduction allows partial recovery.

chain.action: activates GR in CA3 hippocampal neurons
chain.effect: excess glutamate in synapse
excessive Ca²⁺ influx → mitochondrial dysfunction → ROS

chain.target: dendritic retraction in CA3 pyramidal neurons
chain.effect: structural hippocampal damage
neurogenesis decreases → volume loss accelerates
partial hippocampal recovery → improved memory

analogies_th: cortisol เรื้อรัง = กรดที่ค่อยๆ กัดกร่อน hippocampus
ลด stress ทัน = กอบกู้สมองได้บางส่วน — neuroplasticity ยังทำงาน

sources.title: Hippocampal atrophy in recurrent major depression — Sheline YI et al.

mechanisms.label_th: Vagal Tone — Brake System ที่ตรงข้ามกับ SNS
mechanisms.label_en: Vagal Tone (Parasympathetic) as Counter-Regulation to Sympathetic Stress
mechanisms.description_th: Vagus nerve (CN X) เป็น parasympathetic nerve หลักที่เชื่อม brainstem กับ heart, gut, immune cells; high vagal tone (HRV สูง) = ตอบสนองต่อ stress ได้ดี + recovery เร็ว; slow breathing (5-6 breaths/min) → activate baroreflex → NTS ใน medulla → vagal efferent → SA node → HR ลด + cortisol ลด; low vagal tone สัมพันธ์กับ CVD, depression, anxiety
mechanisms.description_en: Vagus nerve (CN X) is primary parasympathetic nerve connecting brainstem to heart/gut/immune; high vagal tone (high HRV) = better stress response and faster recovery; slow breathing (5-6/min) activates baroreflex → NTS → vagal efferents → SA node → HR/BP reduction + cortisol reduction; low HRV = CVD, depression, anxiety risk.

chain.effect: afferent signal to NTS (nucleus tractus solitarius) in medulla

chain.target: vagal efferent output to SA node + AV node
chain.effect: heart rate slows, HRV increases

chain.actor: Vagal signal to adrenal cortex and lymphoid organs
chain.target: cortisol release and systemic inflammation (via cholinergic anti-inflammatory pathway)
chain.effect: cortisol ลด, TNF-α ลด

chain.actor: Regular vagal stimulation (breathing, meditation, cold exposure)
chain.target: vagal tone baseline (HRV increase over weeks)
chain.effect: chronic stress resilience improved

analogies_th: vagal tone = ระบบ brake ของร่างกาย; SNS = accelerator
HRV สูง = รถที่มี brake ดี จึง accelerate ได้แรงโดยไม่หลุดโค้ง

sources.title: How breath-control can change your life — Zaccaro A et al.

mechanisms.label_en: Glucocorticoid Receptor Activation in Visceral Adipocytes Drives Abdominal Fat Storage
mechanisms.description_th: Visceral adipocytes (ไขมันในช่องท้อง) มี GR density สูงกว่า subcutaneous fat; cortisol จับ GR → upregulate lipoprotein lipase (LPL) ใน visceral adipocytes → เพิ่ม triglyceride uptake; cortisol ยัง stimulate hepatic gluconeogenesis → เพิ่ม blood glucose → insulin ขึ้น → fat storage เพิ่ม; visceral fat itself ผลิต cortisol ด้วย (11β-HSD1) → amplification loop
mechanisms.description_en: Visceral adipocytes have higher GR density than subcutaneous fat; cortisol binds GR → upregulates LPL in visceral fat → increases TG uptake; cortisol stimulates hepatic gluconeogenesis → raises insulin → more fat storage; visceral fat expresses 11β-HSD1 (produces local cortisol) → amplification loop.

chain.action: activates GR in visceral adipocytes (high receptor density)
chain.effect: preferential fat uptake and storage in visceral depots
more lipogenesis in all fat depots, especially visceral

chain.action: converts inactive cortisone → active cortisol locally
chain.effect: amplification loop — more local cortisol → more visceral fat
systemic inflammation, insulin resistance → metabolic syndrome

analogies_th: cortisol สูง = คำสั่ง 'เก็บสำรองไว้ที่ท้อง ก่อนเลย'; visceral fat ยิ่งใหญ่ ยิ่งผลิต cortisol เอง = snowball

sources.title: Glucocorticoids and visceral fat — Björntorp P

mechanisms.label_th: Adaptogens — Ashwagandha/Rhodiola กับ HPA Modulation
mechanisms.label_en: Adaptogen Mechanisms: Withanolides and Rosavins Modulate HPA Axis and HSP70
mechanisms.description_th: Adaptogens (Ashwagandha withanolides, Rhodiola rosavins/salidroside) มีกลไกหลายทาง: 1) ลด CRH/ACTH secretion → ลด cortisol; 2) ยับยั้ง cortisol-induced GR downregulation (preserve feedback); 3) modulate Hsp70/Hsp90 (heat shock proteins) → เพิ่ม cell stress resistance; 4) Ashwagandha withanolides → GABA-A receptor positive allosteric modulation → ลด anxiety; Rhodiola salidroside → monoamine oxidase inhibition + 5-HT uptake inhibition
mechanisms.description_en: Adaptogens modulate HPA via: 1) reducing CRH/ACTH secretion; 2) preventing cortisol-induced GR downregulation; 3) upregulating HSP70/HSP90 (cellular stress resistance); 4) Ashwagandha withanolides → GABA-A positive allosteric modulation → anxiolysis; Rhodiola salidroside → MAO inhibition + 5-HT reuptake inhibition → mood support.

chain.effect: anxiolytic effect similar to benzodiazepine mechanism but much weaker/safer

chain.target: CRH secretion from hypothalamus (via NF-κB, cortisol feedback)
chain.effect: reduced ACTH → reduced cortisol
serotonin + dopamine levels rise → fatigue/mood improvement

chain.target: HSP70 (heat shock protein) → cellular stress defense
chain.effect: cells better handle cortisol-induced oxidative stress

analogies_th: adaptogen = ปรับ volume ของ alarm system ให้ดังพอดี — ไม่ปิด แต่ไม่ดังเกิน
withanolide ใน Ashwagandha = key ที่ไปจับ GABA receptor เหมือน benzodize แต่อ่อนกว่า 100 เท่า

sources.title: Safety and efficacy of ashwagandha root extract — Chandrasekhar K et al.

mechanisms.label_th: Mindfulness กับ Prefrontal Cortex — Top-Down Emotional Regulation
mechanisms.label_en: Mindfulness Strengthens PFC-Amygdala Inhibitory Circuit — Top-Down Stress Regulation
mechanisms.description_th: Amygdala (bottom-up threat detector) → triggers stress response; Prefrontal Cortex (top-down regulator) → inhibits amygdala via GABAergic interneurons; chronic stress → PFC thinning → amygdala hyperactivation; mindfulness practice → increase PFC thickness (Lazar 2005 Harvard, 20yr meditators vs control) + reduce amygdala volume/reactivity → improved emotional regulation; mechanism: PFC→amygdala inhibitory synapse strengthened by repetitive mindful attention practice
mechanisms.description_en: Amygdala (bottom-up threat detection) → stress response; PFC (top-down regulator) inhibits amygdala via GABAergic interneurons; chronic stress → PFC thinning → amygdala hyperactivity; mindfulness training increases PFC thickness and reduces amygdala reactivity (Lazar 2005, Hölzel 2011); PFC→amygdala inhibitory synapses strengthened by practice.

chain.effect: stress response initiated
top-down regulation = cortical control of emotional response
stronger inhibitory pathway to amygdala

chain.target: lower cortisol reactivity + faster cortisol recovery
chain.effect: stress resilience: same stressor → smaller cortisol spike + faster return to baseline

analogies_th: PFC = CEO ที่บังคับ amygdala (ระบบความกลัว) ไม่ให้ panic; mindfulness = training ให้ CEO แข็งแรงขึ้น
คนที่ meditate นาน = amygdala เล็กลง PFC ใหญ่ขึ้น — ข้อมูลจาก Harvard MRI

sources.title: Mindfulness meditation programs for psychological stress — Goyal M et al.

mechanisms.label_th: Gut-Brain Stress Axis — Microbiome และ Cortisol Feedback
mechanisms.label_en: Gut-Brain Bidirectional Stress Loop via HPA-Microbiome-Vagal Pathways
mechanisms.description_th: Cortisol ลด mucus layer ใน gut → เพิ่ม permeability → LPS จาก gram-negative bacteria เข้า bloodstream → TLR4 activation → IL-6, TNF-α → systemic inflammation → penetrates BBB → neuroinflammation → worsened anxiety/depression; gut bacteria ผลิต GABA, serotonin (90% of body 5-HT), short-chain FA (propionate, butyrate) → vagus nerve → mood regulation; stress ลด diversity → cycle worsens
mechanisms.description_en: Cortisol reduces gut mucus → increased permeability → LPS enters blood → TLR4 → IL-6/TNF-α → neuroinflammation → worse anxiety; gut bacteria produce GABA, 5-HT (90% of body serotonin), SCFA (butyrate/propionate) → vagal signal → mood; stress reduces gut diversity → bidirectional worsening loop.

chain.effect: gut barrier permeability increases
systemic inflammatory cytokines (IL-6, TNF-α, IL-1β)
IDO pathway: tryptophan → kynurenine (not serotonin) → depression, anxiety
gut barrier integrity; also vagal HDAC inhibition → anti-anxiety signal
less serotonin, less GABA, more leaky gut → feedback worsens anxiety

analogies_th: gut = brain ที่สอง; stress ทำลาย gut → gut ส่งสัญญาณวนกลับทำให้ stress แย่กว่าเดิม
butyrate จาก microbiome = 'น้ำมัน' ที่หล่อ gut-brain axis ให้ทำงานดี
